title: Tapo TP-Link C410 Smart Home Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $119 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Tapo TP-Link C410 Smart Home Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $119 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[brunodla] Good budget camera, a few motion issues but for its price worth it
[gtech] Yeah tends to miss a few seconds at the start and there are a few false positives but at this price is a no brainer if you are after a budget setup.
[Make it so] Do I understand correctly that these don't show up in Google Home?
[mewx] They do show up (including live video footage) if you link your Tapo account in Google Home app
[Timetraveler] I just got a 2 pack for $118
Edit: now showing $119
[ToyInTheAttic2] Sorry, Tapo C410 Kit Solar-Powered Wire-Free 2K Security Cam, 3MP, Night Vision can't be shipped to the address you selected. Please remove the item or select another address
Stupid amazon
[L0zBargain] These are great, but the price of microSD cards is making me think twice…
